injuries.detail: Barlow (back) will be re-evaluated later in the week and is thought to be nearing his 2026-27 season debut, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
James (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.
Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
